===Competitive rewards===

In competitive games, players are given a certain amount of points based on their performance in a game, provided they have killed at least one player:{{CiteNews|url=https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/remaining-getting-around-changes?oldschool=1|title=Remaining Getting Around Changes|newsdate=1 April 2026}}
* 1st place - 6 points
* 2nd place - 5 points
* 3rd/4th place - 4 points
* 5th-9th place - 3 points
* 10th-19th place - 1 point

* Bonus Points (do not stack with each other):
** 3 kills - 2 point
** 5 kills - 3 points

'''Note:''' 

These points can be exchanged for reward items at [[Justine]]'s reward shop, [[Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing]].
